jobs.description_text: Compensation: $200,000–$500,000 + equity (depending on experience and scope) Location: San Francisco Start: ASAP • Applications: Rolling There is a $5k referral bonus for this role. You can refer people through our form https://airtable.com/appYVvzDrNdbVKIaK/pagLIE65fzwkJz6NB/form. We’re hiring a member of technical staff to work closely with the founding team. You'll shape both our products and research direction. Key Responsibilities: - Backend engineering: Design and build scalable infrastructure and systems for AI agents, including containerization, and performance optimization - Machine learning: Contribute to agent science research, and create evaluations for agent performance and behavior - Frontend engineering: Develop oversight interfaces and frontend systems for coding agent monitoring and control - Shape product strategy and research direction in collaboration with the founding team
